moreReplies.description: The node's replies were not read to their end. Call getThread again with this node as the anchor, parentHeight 0, depth at least 1, and repliesCursor set to the cursor when there is one. A marker says that work was not done, never that there is a block; it can turn out empty.

cursor.description: Opaque position to resume from, valid only for this node. Absent when none of the node's replies was read.

postNode.description: A post in a Thread Lens response, hydrated for the caller (see servedAs on the output). Viewer state is the caller's own as this server holds it: a ready member's like, repost and thread mute from its records here; for anyone else none but the block fields. Counts (likeCount, repostCount, replyCount, quoteCount) are the upstream AppView's, each replaced by this server's Constellation count for the post when it has one; a post built from its record alone (when no AppView returned it) has none. viewer.replyDisabled is set on the posts of a thread whose root is a post node of the response, from the root's threadgate and this server's own records, and left out when it cannot be known that way. Labels are this server's own (its operator's, and a restored account's community labeler's), not the caller's labelers'. viewer.embeddingDisabled is present only where this server stores the post's postgate.

moreParents.description: Present and true when this node has a parent the response does not include. Call getThread again with this node as the anchor, depth 0 and parentHeight at least 1.

hiddenByThreadgate.description: Present and true when the thread's root author hid this post: its URI is in the hiddenReplies of the root's threadgate, and the caller is not its author. The same meaning as app.bsky.unspecced.defs#threadItemPost.hiddenByThreadgate. The flag is all a node carries of the gate; only a root post node's own post view keeps its threadgate, as every post view does. A client collapses such a reply, with what is beneath it, as stock does for hidden replies; a flagged anchor or parent is shown with a notice. Flags from several responses for one thread are combined: a response without the flag never clears it.

gapNode.description: A post that is not shown, with a typed reason. Every per-URI failure is a gap rather than an error. A gap never carries a handle, a name, text, counts or a time: the URI is all there is.

moreParents.description: As on postNode. Only on a 'blocked-by-you' or 'blocking-you' gap.

moreReplies.description: As on postNode. Only on a 'blocked-by-you' or 'blocking-you' gap.

hiddenByThreadgate.description: As on postNode, on a gap of any kind. Never on a resolve item.

blockingByListUri.description: Only on a 'blocked-by-you' gap whose block comes through a list rather than a direct block: one list the caller list-blocks that holds the author (the stock concept of viewerState.blockingByList, as the list's URI only). When several apply, the smallest URI. Absent for a direct block, and when the server knows no such list. It names only the caller's own list block, nothing of the author's records.

gap.description: Why the post is not shown. 'blocked-by-you': the caller blocks the author. 'blocking-you': the author blocks the caller. 'block-state-unknown': the server did not fetch the post because it could not check the caller's blocks for its author. 'blocked': a block the ordinary thread view reported that was not looked past: a block between other parties, or one whose author's blocks with the caller could not be checked. Never returned by resolve. 'tier-hidden': every private-tier URI, whether or not it exists. An open set: treat an unknown value as a gap with no content.
